title: Design: long and special matrix names on a tier page and matrix page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with a long name with spaces of at least 60 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Services Preferred Pricing).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, with a long name with no spaces of at least 60 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetServicesPreferredPricingPlan).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
  3. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  4. Click matrix B's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's, matrix B's and matrix C's names stay inside the Matrix column of their own rows.
  • The Work Order Matrix and Part Sale Matrix values stay visible beside them and the page does not scroll sideways.
  • Matrix C's name shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.

Step 3:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 4:

  • Matrix B's title shows its name without covering the Categories line or the three-dot button.
  • The page does not scroll sideways.
  • The Categories line, tabs and grid keep the places of picture 3.2.
